feeds.title: Fehr Trade Blog
feeds.description: Fehr Trade was founded in 2005 by Melissa Fehr, but she's been sewing in every scrap of spare time since 2001, also taking up running at about the same time. In 2013 both interests collided when Melissa released her first digital sewing patterns for activewear, and she hasn't stopped moving or sewing since! So far she's run six full marathons in her own-sewn gear, and also enjoys cycling and bouldering whenever she can.
